m: May your home fill with wealth, health and wisdom, the richest gold of all.
May every diya you light today brighten your path to success. Happy Diwali and Bandi Chhor Divas!
To every brother and sister: may your bond keep growing stronger, together.
Never lose your curiosity. The child in you is the one who keeps learning.
May Chhathi Maiya and the Sun God bless you with energy, discipline and a bright future.
Guru Nanak Dev Ji taught us to work honestly, share with others and stay humble. Lakh lakh vadhaiyan!
May this season bring you joy, peace and the gift of new hope.
New year, new pages. Let's grow a little every single day. I'm with you.
Remembering Swami Vivekananda: arise, awake, and stop not till the goal is reached.
May the Lohri fire burn away your worries and light up your dreams.

n: Makar Sankranti, Pongal & Guru Gobind Singh Jayanti
m: Fly high like a kite, stay rooted like the harvest. Warm wishes on Guru Gobind Singh Ji's Prakash Purab too.
Our Constitution gives us rights. Education gives us the power to use them well. Jai Hind!
May Maa Saraswati bless you with knowledge, wisdom and focus.
May Mahadev give you the strength to stay calm and focused in every storm.
To every woman learning, leading and lifting others: the world is better because of you.
May this Eid bring peace, happiness and success to you and your family.
May your life be as colourful as today. Play safe, smile big!
A day of hope and new beginnings. Wishing you joy and peace.
A new year begins today. May it bring fresh starts and new success.
Happy Baisakhi, Bihu and Puthandu! Today we also honour Dr B.R. Ambedkar, who showed that education is power.
May Lord Ram's values of truth and duty guide every step you take.
May Lord Mahavir's message of peace and non-violence fill your heart.
May this Bakrid bring blessings, kindness and togetherness to your home.
May the light of the Buddha's wisdom bring calm to your mind.
Ten minutes of yoga today. Your mind and body will thank you.
To every teacher who shaped me, thank you. And to my students: you teach me too.
Our heroes won freedom. Building India is now our job. Jai Hind!
A thread of love, a promise of protection. Happy Rakhi to all brothers and sisters!
May Lord Krishna inspire you to do your duty without fear of results.
May Ganpati Bappa remove every obstacle from your path. Ganpati Bappa Morya!
From one teacher to every teacher: thank you for lighting the way. And students, thank you for keeping us learning.
May this harvest festival fill your home with happiness and prosperity.
Nine nights of strength and devotion. May Maa Durga bless your every effort.
Be the change you wish to see. Remembering Bapu and Lal Bahadur Shastri Ji today.
May Maa Durga give you the courage to win every battle in life.
Burn your inner Ravan of laziness and fear. Let good habits win!
Wishing every couple a lifetime of love, trust and togetherness.
May your home fill with wealth, health and wisdom, the richest gold of all.
May every diya you light today brighten your path to success. Happy Diwali and Bandi Chhor Divas!
To every brother and sister: may your bond keep growing stronger, together.
May Chhathi Maiya and the Sun God bless you with energy, discipline and a bright future.
Guru Nanak Dev Ji taught us to work honestly, share and stay humble. Happy Children's Day too!
May this season bring you joy, peace and the gift of new hope.
New year, new pages. Let's grow a little every single day. I'm with you.
